groups.defect: Narrowing BuildIndex locking permits concurrent same-key builds to collide, duplicate work, and overwrite cached indexes; unlocked TotalDocs cache iteration also races with cache writes.
groups.rationale: All three report the same concurrent same-key build defect caused by narrowing the critical section. s_4cfadd1d additionally reports the TotalDocs map-read race, which the unified comment must preserve.

groups.defect: Starting the watcher after search initialization creates a window in which writes during index construction are missed.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same initialization-order defect and missed-event window. They emphasize different consequences for watch delivery and search consistency, but restoring watcher-first ordering or replaying the gap addresses both.
